name: TM-Shippers: Spot Market API
description: Endpoints to allow carriers to retrieve Spot Market postings and retrieve and update offers. This API only supports offers for Truckload loads. This API supports both basic, detailed, and contract offers. A basic offer is one with a single total charge. A detailed offer supports a single base charge and multiple accessorial charges metered to a variety of load metrics (weight, distance et al.). Contract offers are pre-defined by the TMS and can contain multiple base, tax, and accessorial charges. Basic, contract, and detailed offers may be submitted when the requires_detailed_offer field of the SpotMarket load is set to true. In this situation a basic offer would be converted by this API to a detailed offer containing a FLAT base rate. When the requires_detailed_offer field of the SpotMarket load is set to false, only basic and contract offers may be submitted.
